page.layout: Top: a block of four index lines, with page numbers at the right. Below a rule: a large heading "I N" with a line "A" beneath it, the rest cut off. Then one column of index entries, with a drop-cap A at its head, page numbers at the right.; Running head at the top, right of centre. Above a rule: columns of index entries from the previous part, in one column. Below the rule: a heading in large capitals with an ornament, then a list in one column of italic entries with page numbers at the right. "FINIS." centred below the list. A woodcut ornament at the foot.; One column of index entries at the top right, under a large Z initial; below a rule, a heading running across the right side; below it one column of index entries, names with page numbers at the right.
page.notes: The drop-cap A is printed as one large letter standing beside "Curfius"; I have given it as its own line, following the index convention. The heading line after "I N" is cut off at the right edge, so its wording is illegible. "3IO" for Baldus is copied as printed. The mark before "306" for S. Ambrosius is doubtful and may be a stray character. "Aefculapius" and its number are set close together in print. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The heading letters at the left of "N D" and "P P E N D I C." are cut or faint, so the full word of the heading is not legible. Its letters are copied as they show. The ornament at the foot has no text. The Z initial at the top is a large decorative letter joined to "enobia" and "eno Imp.", read as Zenobia and Zeno Imp. The heading shows only the letters "E X" and "I S." as printed. Numerals in old-style figures (311, 302, 303, 305, 301, 300, 299, 154, 99, 75) are read as ordinary digits; the "3II" forms are read as 311. "Theophraftus Erefius" has its page number 299 printed on the line below the name.
